text:
Maya: Morning — quick async check-in. What I did: finished draft for the 'cost vs latency' benchmark post and updated the content calendar with tentative publish slots. Blockers: waiting on final 99p latency numbers from eng and the hero image from design. Today: finalize copy + queue for review. @Owen can you drop the 99p numbers for Dedicated vs Hosted here?

Owen: Sure — 99p for Dedicated (model-x, batch=8) yesterday was ~118ms, Hosted ~210ms. Uploaded raw CSV + notebook to the benchmark bucket: s3://redwood-bench/runs/2026-03-17_run1.csv. I’ll open a PR for the perf graphs in ~30m.

Tom: Reviewed the draft intro, looks tight. Two tiny nit picks: change "latency savings" -> "median latency savings" in the first para, and add a footnote about warm vs cold starts. Otherwise lgtm.

Priya: Landing page copy almost ready — pushed a branch: feature/bench-landing. Need the hero image (png, 1440x700) and a short CTA line from design. @Lina can you chase design?

Lina: On it — pinged @Design #design-assets, they said they can deliver by 1pm PT. If we need a placeholder, I can drop a temporary SVG.

Maya: Awesome. @Owen once your PR is up can you tag me and @Tom for a quick look so we can inline the charts? Also, any notable variance across regions we should call out?

Owen: Will tag. Region note: eu-west had ~5% higher p99 due to a transient node reboot during the run; I filtered that from the primary graphs but added an appendix table.

Tom: Minor thing — can we add a short blurb about how batching settings affect user-perceived latency vs throughput? I can write 2-3 lines.

Priya: For launch coordination: propose publish window Tue 9am PT, share on X + newsletter slice. Need final copy + charts by EOD Mon to run legal check.

Maya: EOD Monday works for me if eng delivers graphs today.

Lina: Design will have hero by 12:45pm PT.

Owen: PR opened: github.com/redwood/benchmarks/pull/412 — includes notebook + generated PNGs. Tagging @Maya @Tom.

Maya: Reviewing now. Blocker update for my side: none besides waiting on final tiny copy change after graphs.

Jules (bench-bot): Benchmark run complete: run_2026_03_17_01. Summary: median 21ms, p95 62ms, p99 118ms (Dedicated). Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/runs/run_2026_03_17_01/

Tom: Quick CR on the PR — left two comments about axis labels and caption. Should be quick.

Priya: Thanks all. If everything lands by 3pm PT, I’ll schedule publish and draft social posts.

Maya: Great — keep updates here. If anyone's blocked ping me directly. :thumbsup:
